dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive dataset of riverine levee overtopping events for advancing risk assessment

description: A comprehensive dataset of riverine levee overtopping events for advancing risk assessment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Stefan Flynn et al. Earthen levees are the primary flood protection infrastructure worldwide, with overtopping recognized as the most prevalent mode of their failure. Despite its significance, detailed field data on overtopping events are often limited and fragmented. Here we present the Levee Loading and Incident Dataset - Overtopping (LLID-OT) version 1.0, a curated dataset of 487 overtopping events in U.S. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 106409 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
